sources.label: Morphe patches for streaming and news phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Removes the app's access to your location while it is closed or in the background.
Stops the app from scanning for Bluetooth devices and beacons, and hides paired devices.
Turns off Sparky, Walmart's AI assistant, and the AI features on item and search pages.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hides the cell towers your phone sees from the app.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hides nearby Wi-Fi networks and the name of your network from the app.
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.

sources.label: R2bEEaton Walmart
sources.author: R2bEEaton Walmart
patch_list: Opens the 'Lists' tab by default when tapping 'My Items' instead of the 'Reorder' tab.
Restores the 'Find item' button on linked shopping list items so you can link a different product.
Adds a dedicated 'Flash tag' sibling pill button next to Aisle indicators throughout the app to illuminate electronic shelf tags directly.
Displays real-time in-store stock availability badges on list and checklist items (e.g. In Stock, Low Stock / Only X left, Out of Stock).
Removes the Shop tab entirely from the bottom navigation bar and opens to My Items by default.
Adds a 'Plan my route' map icon to the Walmart 'Shop in-store' checklist screen that opens Walmart's own in-store map with every list item's aisle pinned at once.

sources.label: Walmart app Morphe patch for removing annoyances
sources.author: Ron Walmart
patch_list: Stops the store mode sheet from popping up on its own when you open the app in a store. Location, store-specific pricing, the in-store search filter and the store mode banner/button still work.
